question: Does a mechanism developed on two groups carry the meaning of observations (measurand, conditions) to categories and publishers it never saw, and to a category whose own teaching is withheld?

corpus.status: gold sets of Phase270-272, Step 1C, Step 1D-B; spent by earlier phases, never held-out in absolute terms; independent of the S87b mechanism

developmentRule: only development-group observations are read (content and failures) while building; other groups are seen only as aggregate counts until the mechanism is frozen
check: the other 12 category-publisher groups; plus every group with its own category teaching withheld (untaught state)
primaryMetrics: condition representability (stated conditions carried by a typed axis)
measurand carried (taught measurement or general metric)
precision of produced axes on a blind sample, annotated by a separate agent before scoring
report: overall, per group, worst group, untaught state; coverage and precision together; development and check separately
stopRule: at most three reformulations on development data; then freeze and run check once; the first check run is committed unchanged
